Recipe: Windows AI dev machine from zero

Goal: ChatGPT-style assistant + automations where no data leaves the building
Stack (all in this sheet): Ollama (or vLLM at scale) · Open WebUI · LiteLLM · Qdrant · Docling · n8n · Langfuse · Coolify · Tailscale
How it fits together: LiteLLM sits in front of every model and issues per-department keys with budgets. Open WebUI is the staff-facing chat with document RAG. n8n automates the workflows. Langfuse logs everything for audit. Deployed and updated through Coolify, reached over Tailscale.
Rough cost: Hardware/VPS + your time; all software free

Goal: Accurate answers with citations from PDFs, scans and tables
Stack (all in this sheet): Docling / MinerU · sentence-transformers (embeddings + reranker) · Qdrant or pgvector · LlamaIndex · Ragas · Langfuse
How it fits together: Parse to structured Markdown → chunk by headings → embed → hybrid search → rerank top 20 to top 5 → answer with citations. Build a 50-question test set from the client's documents and track faithfulness with Ragas.

Stack (all in this sheet): Crawl4AI · Scrapling · Scrapy · Firecrawl (hard targets) · Instructor · DuckDB · Polars · n8n (scheduling)
How it fits together: Deterministic selectors first, LLM extraction only where layouts vary. Land raw HTML, parse into Parquet, analyse with DuckDB. n8n schedules runs and alerts on anomalies. Respect robots.txt and site terms.

Goal: A content series rendered from text files
Stack (all in this sheet): Playwright screenshots (HTML → PNG) or Satori · sharp · Remotion · FFmpeg · auto-editor · WhisperX · Fontshare / Uncut · Cap
How it fits together: Slides are HTML/CSS templates filled from Markdown; Playwright renders 1080×1350 PNGs. Remotion animates the same components for Reels. auto-editor removes silences from talking-head clips; WhisperX produces word-timed captions.

Recipe: Fine-tune and serve a private model
Goal: A domain model that beats prompting on your eval
Stack (all in this sheet): synthetic-data-kit (Meta) / distilabel · Unsloth → Axolotl · Weights & Biases · lm-evaluation-harness · RunPod / Modal · vLLM or Ollama (GGUF)
How it fits together: Turn documents into instruction data, LoRA-tune on a rented GPU, compare against the base model and a prompted frontier model, then export to GGUF for Ollama or serve with vLLM.
Rough cost: A few dollars of GPU per experiment

Goal: Natural spoken interaction, local where possible
Stack (all in this sheet): Silero VAD · faster-whisper or whisper.cpp · LLM via LiteLLM · Kokoro TTS / Piper · LiveKit Agents or Pipecat
How it fits together: VAD decides when speech starts and ends, streaming STT transcribes, the LLM answers with tool calls, TTS speaks. LiveKit/Pipecat handle transport and interruptions. On constrained hardware keep VAD + wake word on-device and stream the rest.
Rough cost: Free locally; per-minute if using cloud STT/TTS

Goal: UI that does not look AI-generated

Recipe: An agent product you can sell
